mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Current conditions show 50 degrees and overcast skies near Verona City Hall, with temperatures dropping to an overnight low of 49 degrees and no rain predicted. Tonight features a Third Quarter moon, and while an ISS pass occurs tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city updates, alternate-side winter street parking regulations run from November 20th to April 1st to keep roads safe and clear for snow removal. Additionally, the Water Utility has partnered with HydroCorp to conduct residential and commercial cross-connection control inspections to protect community drinking water.

Happening today, residents can visit the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol Square or enjoy live music at local spots including Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, trivia enthusiasts can join the fun at Hop Haus Brewing Co on Wednesday, November 4th.
In police news, on Saturday, October 25th, officers located a vehicle stopped for twenty minutes at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue and arrested the driver for an O W I first offence.
Culver's is open until 10:30 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by for today's flavor of the day, Mint Explosion.
